title: DOT-05: Missing-document acquisition ticket
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named implementing agency

Likely custodian: DOT Office of the Secretary, Office of Grants and Financial Assistance.

Directive element 2: Risk rating, monitoring, and response method — Not established by located public record. Locator: No separately public exact artifact acquired as of 2026-08-02.
Directive element 3: Coverage across operating administrations — Not established by located public record. Locator: No separately public exact artifact acquired as of 2026-08-02.

Stop rule: Stop the bounded public-search pass after the named program, publication, reading-room, budget, and current GAO surfaces have been checked; reopen on a new exact-title, correspondence, attachment, or custodian lead.
Reopening trigger: A new agency attachment, public exact-title match, successor directive, GAO page update, or named custodian release.

Next action: Route the exact-title query to DOT Office of the Secretary, Office of Grants and Financial Assistance; monitor the named repositories and GAO page for a public attachment. No request has been submitted by FTFN.
GAO acceptance state: GAO says submitted actions are incomplete.
why_it_matters: The queue turns a generic missing-or-adjacent evidence gap into a reproducible retrieval route or a bounded page-level sufficiency record without claiming authority FTFN does not have.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-05 and its exact recommendation identity.
Names the artifact, likely custodian, repositories, search terms, stop rule, and reopening trigger.

evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
